The phone app sends nothing unencrypted and follows an instance's own relay. Every change is listed in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/knightloader/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

## ⚡ Improved

- **The phone app follows an instance's own relay.** An instance on a relay of its own puts that relay's address in the QR code under the twelve words, and the app pairs there when it scans the code. It accepts the address only over `wss://`. Typed words still pair on the project relay.
- **The phone app sends nothing unencrypted.** It no longer allows plain HTTP. A connection saved before 1.5.0 that points at an `http://` address asks to be added again with the twelve words instead of failing with a network error.
- **The README invites testers** instead of warning against installing KnightLoader. It also says the logo is licensed under AGPL-3.0-only like the code, while the KnightLoader name and logo stay trademarks.
